brief.text: Good morning Jebin! Tue Nov 3. No appointments today — enjoy the open day. Use it well, stay consistent, and keep building toward your goals!

workout.text: AM upper+abs: floor press 3x10, rows 3x10/arm, shoulder press 3x10, curls 3x10, triceps 3x10, dead bugs 3x8/side. PM lower+abs: goblet squats 3x12, deadlifts 3x10, glute bridges 3x15, calf raises 3x15, plank 3x40s, twists 3x12/side.

next.text: Next: dental appointment today at 10am. Take it easy and be ready on time.
